title: Agent access
description: Create separate credentials for agents that work with this mailbox. Each key has its own permissions and can be revoked.
label: Key name
readHint: Read messages and private attachments in this mailbox.
draftHint: Create and edit drafts in this mailbox.
sendHint: Select only for an agent you authorize to send email from this mailbox. Without it, the agent asks for your approval: you get an email and send the draft from the dashboard.
expirationHint: Use your device's local date and time, or a shortcut. Empty = never expires. A week before it expires you get an email to swap the key.
futureExpiration: Choose an expiration date and time in the future.
error: The action could not be completed. Check the list and try again.
refreshError: The key was created, but the list could not be updated. Save its token before closing.
secretHint: This token is shown only during this opening. Save it securely: it cannot be retrieved after you close or dismiss it.
copyError: The token could not be copied. Select and copy it manually.
emptyBody: Create one key for each agent that needs access to this mailbox.
revokeSuccess: Key revocation confirmed. This credential no longer grants access.
mcpHint: Agents that speak MCP use this mailbox as tools: list, read, save drafts and, with the send permission, send. Pick the client, copy and paste; the text carries this key, so keep it just as safe.

team.open: Connect an agent to several mailboxes
team.title: Agent with access to several mailboxes
team.description: One credential for the agent to work in the mailboxes you choose. Each request names the mailbox, like "get the code in mailbox X"; when it names none, the default mailbox is used. Every mailbox keeps its own permissions, limits, send approval and activity record.
team.mailboxesHint: Only your active mailboxes are listed.
team.noDefault: None: the agent always names the mailbox
team.emptyBody: Create one so an agent can serve more than one mailbox with the same key.
team.mailboxCount: {count, plural, =0 {no active mailbox} one {# mailbox} other {# mailboxes}}
team.mcpHint: Agents that speak MCP use these mailboxes as tools: each tool names the mailbox by address, and mailbox_list_accounts shows which ones are open. Pick the client, copy and paste; the text carries this key, so keep it just as safe.

edit.label: Edit the credential {label}
edit.title: Edit "{label}"
edit.hint: The agent keeps the same token; nothing changes on its side. Mailboxes you remove lose access at once, and the agent's sends still queued from them don't go out. Without "Send without approval", its next sends wait for your approval.
edit.hintOauth: The app stays connected over OAuth; no new authorization needed. Mailboxes you remove lose access at once, and the agent's sends still queued from them don't go out. Without "Send without approval", its next sends wait for your approval.
edit.saved: Credential updated. The agent keeps the same token.
edit.savedRefreshError: The credential was updated, but the list couldn't be reloaded. Close and reopen to see it.
edit.conflict: Someone changed this credential while you were editing. We reloaded what applies now: review it and save again.
edit.gone: This credential was revoked or expired and can no longer be edited.
edit.forbidden: One of the chosen mailboxes isn't yours or is suspended. Untick it and save again.
edit.quota: One of the mailboxes you added already has 25 agent credentials. Revoke one there before adding it.
edit.invalid: Check the expiry (it must be in the future) and the default mailbox (it must be ticked).
edit.unavailableBox: Unavailable now (suspended or being deleted). You can only remove it.

where.claude-code: Run it in a terminal, in the project folder (or with --scope user for every project). Then /mcp in Claude Code shows mepmail-correio connected.
where.claude-desktop: In Settings → Developer → Edit config, merge it into {file} and restart Claude Desktop. Needs Node.js installed (npx fetches @mepmail/mcp).
where.cursor: Merge it into {file} (or .cursor/mcp.json in the project) and check Settings → MCP.
where.vscode: Merge it into the project's {file} (or run MCP: Open User Configuration) and start the server from Copilot's MCP list.
where.codex: Merge it into {file} and restart Codex. Needs Node.js installed (npx fetches @mepmail/mcp).
where.other: Any MCP client with Streamable HTTP: server at {url} with this Authorization header.

test.ok: Connected in {ms} ms: {count, plural, =0 {no mailbox open right now} one {# mailbox open} other {# mailboxes open}}.
test.rejected: The key was refused: check that it was copied whole and has not been revoked or expired.
test.unreachable: The Mail endpoint did not answer. Try again in a few seconds.
test.unexpected: The endpoint answered in an unexpected way. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.
test.unavailable: unavailable right now (mailbox suspended or owned by someone else)

oauth.title: Connect without pasting a key
oauth.body: Add the MCP server {url} to your client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code). It opens the browser: you sign in, tick the mailboxes the agent may use and allow it. To revoke, use Revoke below or Connected apps.

desktop.title: Connect on this computer
desktop.body: One click sets the agent up to use this mailbox through the MepMail app. The key stays in the system's credential vault, never in a config file. The system asks you to confirm each step.
desktop.ok: Done: {client} is set up. Quit and reopen {client} to see the MepMail tools.
desktop.notInstalled: {client} was not found on this computer.

live.waiting: Waiting for the agent to use the key… it shows here as soon as it connects.
live.connected: Connected: the agent used this key {when}.

revokeConfirm: Revoke “{label}”? The agent loses access right away.
revokeConfirmCredential: Revoke all of “{label}”? The agent loses access to every mailbox of this credential, not only this one.
quota: This mailbox already has 25 active keys. Revoke one you no longer use to create another.

panel.draftedBy: Written by agent {label} · approved by you
panel.error: Could not load the agents right now.
panel.changed: The draft changed since the request. The list was refreshed.

approvals.title: Waiting for your approval
approvals.empty: Nothing waiting for you. When an agent without the send permission asks, it shows here.
approvals.confirm: {count, plural, one {Send to # recipient?} other {Send to # recipients?}}
approvals.discardConfirm: The draft goes to Trash and is not sent.
approvals.sent: Send approved. It is going out now.

errors.recipientBlocked: Not sent: one of the recipients is blocked because an earlier message bounced (address doesn't exist or refused it) or was marked as spam by the person. Open the draft, remove that recipient and send again.
errors.recipientBlockedNamed: Not sent: {count, plural, one {{recipients} is blocked} other {{recipients} are blocked}} because an earlier message bounced (address doesn't exist or refused it) or was marked as spam by the person.
errors.quota: Not sent: the plan reached this period's limit. The draft is kept.
errors.trialLimit: Not sent: the free trial reached its sending limit for now. The draft is kept.
errors.unavailable: Not sent: MepMail Mail sending is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: Not sent: this mailbox can't send right now (domain not verified, mailbox suspended or access changed).
errors.generic: Not sent. Nothing went out; try again.
errors.unblockedAll: Recipients unblocked. You can send again.

agents.title: Agents with access
agents.empty: No agents connected to your mailboxes.
agents.asksYou: asks for your approval to send
agents.revokeConfirm: {count, plural, one {The agent loses access to this mailbox at once.} other {The agent loses access to the # mailboxes at once.}}
